thread:
Anna L: Kicking off region-by-region rollout for v3.14.0 — plan: US -> EU -> APAC. US starting at 25% traffic for 10m smoke. DeployBot just kicked it off.

DeployBot: started rollout v3.14.0 slice=us traffic=25% image=redwood-inference:v3.14.0 (canary-window=10m)

Diego M: ACK. I can watch latency & thermal. any immediate hot spots?

Anna L: US preflight snapshot: headroom ~2200 tok/s, warm pool=8 GPUs, expected p50=110ms. Rollback thresholds: p95 > 400ms OR error rate > 0.6% sustained 5m.

Maria G: Copy. Dashboard link: https://console.redwood/dash/rollout/v3.14 — I'll post alerts to #eng-oncall if we see slips :eyes:

DeployBot: smoke tests passed. canary qps=1.2k, autoscale healthy, kv-cache-hit=98.3%

Jonathan K: noticed a small bump in KV cache misses at 09:17 UTC — added ~280ms to a few streams, keeping an eye.

Sara P: Quick question — if we see memory pressure, will deploybot auto-fallback to the smaller variant?

Anna L: Yes — fallback model redwood-lite-3b is configured in routing policy. Manual pin also supported. Example pin command: `/deploybot pin region=eu image=redwood-inference:v3.13.9`

Diego M: Good to know. Also FYI for EU/APAC: set thermal buffer before APAC.

OpsRunbookBot: rollout-checklist: canary_ok=true, capacity_ok=true, throttle_multiplier=1.2, rollback_policy=defined

Maria G: Earlier OOM alarm resolved after warm-pool scale. Suggest APAC buffer=1.4x to avoid hot-start thrash.

Anna L: Agreed. Setting APAC buffer=1.4x now.

DeployBot: updated policy: apac buffer=1.4x. Next slice will wait 30m after US stable.

Jonathan K: US stable after 18m. p95=250ms, error_rate=0.12% — looks clean to proceed.

Anna L: Proceeding to EU at 10:20 UTC. EU rollout plan: 15% -> 40% in 20m increments, canary window 12m.

Diego M: Quick reminder of rollback triggers for EU: >=0.5% errors sustained over 10m OR p95 > 600ms for 8m OR thermal-throttle events >=3 within 5m.

Maria G: I'll escalate and run `/deploybot rollback region=eu` if we hit thresholds.

DeployBot: starting eu rollout slice=eu traffic=15% image=redwood-inference:v3.14.0

Anna L: EU ramping. Keep dashboards open. Release notes (short): https://confluence/redwood/release/v3.14 — includes KV cache improvement and quant opt.

Jonathan K: Saw a transient spike at EU canary +5m — p95 briefly to 480ms, back to ~310ms after autoscale. Continuing monitor.

Sara P: If we need immediate mitigation, fallback route is `route=fallback-3b` and pin command shown above. Ops has the script: ```/ops/pin-and-recover --region eu --to redwood-lite-3b```

Diego M: EU looks stable after 22m. p95=320ms, error_rate=0.18%. Green to schedule APAC.

Anna L: Scheduling APAC in ~90m (to respect daytime support and warm pools). Final checklist: release notes posted, smoke tests passed in US/EU, fallback policy validated.

OpsRunbookBot: final-status: US=stable, EU=stable, APAC=scheduled. next_actions=[wait_90m, confirm-warm-pool, notify-support-window]

Maria G: I'll bump APAC thermal buffer and leave alerts on. Good run — will post post-mortem if anything odd shows up. :thumbsup:

DeployBot: rollout v3.14.0 summary: US ok (25%->stable), EU ok (15%->40% stable). APAC scheduled at 12:15 UTC.

Anna L: Thanks team. If anyone sees a threshold, call rollback early. Otherwise, we'll proceed with APAC and then finalize release notes and close the rollout thread.
